Pieces could be selected/switched via CLICK on a piece’s position; the currently selected piece was the one that moved in response. Attempts to move a piece (including via CLICK-driven movement/interaction) failed when blocked by walls/obstacles or other blocking conditions, leaving the piece in place while still consuming a step. Solving required positioning multiple selectable pieces so that all '+' goal tiles were covered at the same time.
